projectDescription: A portable governance framework for Claude Code agents that enforces a goal/method/green-light permission model, cost-aware model delegation, and file-grounded context discipline to prevent irreversible autonomous actions.
keyFeatures: Goal/method/green-light permission model — only a green light lets the agent act
Four-step check that runs before any write/change action
Hot zone classification for irreversible or outward-facing actions
PreToolUse enforcement hook (hard backstop) that blocks hot tool calls before they run
SessionStart hook that automatically injects AGENT_POLICY.md into context
Cost-aware model delegation with tiering (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus) and subagent depth limits
Context discipline to keep agent sessions grounded in files rather than chat history
Audit trail (.keel/audit.jsonl) logging every enforcement decision
Ready-made policy packs for Next.js/Vercel, Supabase, and generic web apps
Runtime-neutral open specification (SPEC.md) enabling Keel-compatible implementations
CI/headless support — hot actions denied automatically when no human is present
publicApiSurface: authorization-protocol skill — four-step check before any write/change action
model-delegation skill — cheapest model selection and subagent depth enforcement
context-discipline skill — file-based state, session handoff rules
SessionStart hook (inject-policy.cjs) — injects AGENT_POLICY.md at session start
PreToolUse hook (enforce-policy.cjs) — intercepts hot tool calls before execution
AGENT_POLICY.md format — hot zones, source-of-truth files, standing approvals, machine-readable keel-policy block
keel-policy fenced block — hot_paths, hot_commands, standing_allow_commands, standing_allow_paths
.keel/audit.jsonl — JSONL audit log of every enforcement decision
KEEL_NONINTERACTIVE / CI env var — triggers headless deny mode
Spec conformance surface — §3 four-step check, §4 hot defaults, §5 following-through conditions, §6 delegation limits, §7 AGENT_POLICY.md format, §8 conformance criteria
